title: About Us
html:
Priya Metal Mart brings traditional Indian kitchenware to homes across India. From iron and cast iron cookware to everyday kitchen tools, we choose products that are built to last.

Good quality, friendly service and honest pricing are what we care about most. Have a question? We are always happy to hear from you.

title: FAQ
html:
How do I order?

Pick your products, add them to your cart, then go to checkout and enter your delivery address and payment choice.

Do I need an account?

No. You can check out as a guest or sign in to your account.

How will my order reach me?

We ship to the address you enter at checkout and send you tracking details by email.
